summary: New pricing page with detailed plans for Amp and Code Search

change_summary.what_changed: New pricing page with detailed plans for Amp and Code Search
specific_changes: Introduction of Amp pricing plans: Amp, Amp Teams, and Amp Enterprise
Code Search pricing plans: Enterprise Starter and Enterprise Search
Detailed features and limitations for each plan
FAQ section added for clarification on pricing and plans

strategic_analysis.business_impact: The new pricing plans could lead to increased revenue streams for Sourcegraph, as well as improved competitiveness in the market.
market_signals: Sourcegraph is targeting individual developers, small teams, and large enterprises with its pricing plans
The company is emphasizing the value of its AI coding assistant and codebase search features
strategic_analysis.competitive_implications: The introduction of new pricing plans could put pressure on competitors to revisit their own pricing strategies, potentially leading to a market-wide shift in pricing dynamics.
strategic_analysis.strategic_direction: Sourcegraph appears to be focusing on expanding its customer base and increasing revenue through targeted pricing plans and feature development.

pricing: Amp: $10 free credit trial, at-cost pricing
Amp Teams: $10 free credit trial per user, at-cost pricing, single sign-on
Amp Enterprise: 50% more expensive than individual and team usage, single sign-on, zero LLM retention
Enterprise Starter: $19 per user, monthly, up to 50 devs
Enterprise Search: $49 per user, monthly, 25+ devs
